This unit has 2 ice settings, but I’ve found that the small ice setting makes the cubes so small that the ejector can’t push them into the tray, which makes the sensors think the ice tray is full. However, on the large setting, that’s not an issue and the cubes aren’t super big, so that works for us. When initially turning it on , though, it always defaults to the small setting and takes several attempts at changing it for the ice maker to hold the large ice setting. The ice itself is a softer ice, which we like. We use it when we camp so we make the ice and then put it in the freezer, because it doesn’t keep the ice frozen, but it makes enough ice fast enough for us to maintain a good amount while we’re at the campsite. Overall we are very happy with this unit, but gave it 4 stars because of not being able to use the small ice setting and difficulty getting it to hold the large setting.

I can't recommend spending this kind of money on a product that started off with issues.  There's no help online for this problem, they just want u to contact the manufacturer and go from there.  I don't have the time or patience to sit on the phone and miss work or the little time I have off to try and work this out over the phone. [[VIDEOID:bec1fc214a91001602aaaaef6ed5d68a]] I’m really satisfied with this and it doesn’t even belong to me. I purchased this for/with my wife. She’s an ice fiend! Lol. This makes ice really fast. Apparently the directions say 8 minutes but it certainly seems faster than that. Do one activity and you have ice. The video I uploaded should help. It gives you 8 cubes at one time; as much as the scooper can scoop (with good precision). I think this product is less expensive than it’s worth. Probably our 2nd best buy. The science of it is awesome too… a good thing to get your children intrigued to look into. Don’t think about it … just get it.

This product has worked very well for the past year. I have only used clean water, but my tap water is a bit hard and I believe this has caused a sensor or other component within the machine to have trouble sensing the water level.

It makes ice pretty quickly. 1 full container is probably good for 6-7 pretty full glasses of ice.

My machine basically died after 14 months of continuous operation. In retrospect, I think that using filtered water will improve the lifespan of this machine.

The machine has acted temperamental before, occasionally not sensing the water level. Usually turning it off for an hour would fix it.

I will give 4 stars because it occasionally breaks down and barely lasted more than a year, but I feel this might be related to my own hard water and it has otherwise performed well. Therefore I will only take off one star.

The shipment arrived quickly and without any apparent damage. After setting it up per the instruction, it was immediately apparent that the unit is defective. When plugged in and turned on, the unit started to vibrated and 'walked' itself across the countertop. The vibration would eventually stop, only to start up a little while later. After 6 hours, the unit did not produce any ice even though the ice tray inside appears to move as it should. I unplugged it and returned it to Amazon. The inconsistent quality issue seems consistent with other feedbacks.
